    c.coupon_id AS "优惠券编号",
    c.coupon_name AS "优惠券名称",
    COUNT(r.receipt_id) AS "领取数量",
    COUNT(u.usage_id) AS "使用数量",
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(r.receipt_id) > 0 
        THEN ROUND(COUNT(u.usage_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(r.receipt_id), 2) 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS "使用率(%)"
FROM coupons c
LEFT JOIN coupon_receipts r ON c.coupon_id = r.coupon_id
LEFT JOIN coupon_usages u ON r.receipt_id = u.receipt_id
GROUP BY c.coupon_id, c.coupon_name
ORDER BY "领取数量" DESC
LIMIT 200
records.analysis: 结果统计了各优惠券的领取数量、使用数量及使用率。例如，无门槛券043领取61次，使用25次，使用率为40.98%；满减券158领取60次，使用32次，使用率为53.33%。

records.query: 计算各站内搜索关键词的搜索次数和转化率，按搜索次数降序取前20名
records.sql:
SELECT 
    keyword AS "搜索关键词",
    COUNT(search_id) AS "搜索次数",
    ROUND(SUM(converted) * 100.0 / COUNT(search_id), 2) AS "转化率(%)"
FROM search_events
GROUP BY keyword
ORDER BY "搜索次数" DESC
LIMIT 20
records.analysis: 搜索次数最多的关键词为“家居生活”（277次，转化率6.86%），而转化率最高的关键词为“夏季”（11.74%，搜索247次）。
